title: 지하철 표지판 읽기: 어디에서 갈아타요? 어디로 나가요?
objective: By the end, you can read a Korean subway sign and find the transfer way, the line number, the direction, and your exit number.
summary: Learners read Korean subway signs to find where to change lines and which exit to use.
note: All station names and numbers on this sheet are made up for practice.

task.title: Read the signs and answer
task.line: Use the signs and words on page 1 to answer each question.

sections.heading: A sign in the station (example: 별빛역)
paragraphs: 나가는 곳 Way Out ← 1·2번 출구 | 3·4번 출구 →

items.text: Follow this sign to change to another line.
It means the same as 갈아타기. You often see it on screens and maps.
Follow this sign to leave the station.
A door or stairs out of the station.
Every exit has a number. Read numbers as 일, 이, 삼, 사 + 번.
The number of the subway line. Each line also has its own color.
The direction the train goes. Check that your stop is on this side.
The place where you wait and get on the train.
Look for it if you have a big bag or a stroller.

sections.heading: Reading tip
paragraphs: Read the sign in this order: arrow (← →), line number (호선), direction (방면), exit number (번 출구). The arrow tells you which way to walk.

exercises: Which sign do you follow? Write 갈아타는 곳 or 나가는 곳: ① 지하철에서 내렸어요. 이제 집에 가요. ② 2호선에서 내렸어요. 이제 4호선으로 바꿔 타요.
Read the sign. Which way do you go? Answer in English (left or right): 나가는 곳 ← 1~4번 출구 | 5~8번 출구 → / 친구: "6번 출구에서 만나요."
Fill in the blank with 호선, 출구, or 방면: ① 6____은 어디에서 타요? ② 공원은 2번 ____로 나가세요. ③ 꽃길역 ____ 지하철이 와요.
Read the screen and answer in Korean. Which lines can you change to here? 이번 역: 숲속역 | 환승: 3호선 · 9호선
Put the steps in order: (가) 4번 출구로 밖에 나가요. (나) 지하철에서 내려요. (다) 나가는 곳 표지를 따라가요.
answers: ① 나가는 곳 ② 갈아타는 곳
Right (→). Exits 5 to 8 are on the right.
① 호선 ② 출구 ③ 방면
